step1_analysis.description: A basic PMOS current mirror that duplicates a reference current to provide biasing for other circuit blocks, such as the preamplifier stages mentioned in the paper.

paper_reference.title: Design of a Low-Noise Preamplifier for Nerve Cuff Electrode Recording

mirror_ratio.description: Ratio of the output current to the input reference current.

sky130_expected.calculation: W/L of both transistors are identical (5u/0.5u), so the ratio should be approximately 1.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Current mirrors with identical dimensions have a nominal ratio of 1. Slight mismatch may occur due to channel length modulation (lambda) since VDS of XM2 is VGS, while VDS of XM3 is -1.8V (drain tied to GND).

power_consumption.description: Total power dissipated by the current mirror.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on an assumed 10uA reference current and 1.8V supply in SKY130. The paper's 1.3 mW applies to the full preamplifier.

bandwidth.description: -3dB bandwidth of the current transfer function.

sky130_expected.calculation: Pole is at gm/Cgs. gm ~ 100uS, Cgs ~ 8fF. f_pole = 100uS / (2*pi*8fF) ~ 2 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The current mirror is a wideband structure compared to the preamplifier, limited only by the parasitic capacitances of the diode-connected device.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure mirror ratio, power consumption, and bandwidth of the PMOS current mirror.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for PMOS Current Mirror
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM2 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 GND N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

VVDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
IREF N0_src 0 DC 10u AC 1u PULSE(5u 15u 1n 1n 1n 5u 10u)
VIREF N0_src N0 DC 0

.control
* DC Analysis
op
let i_in = i(VIREF)
let i_out = -i(VVDD) - i(VIREF)
let mirror_ratio = i_out / i_in
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print mirror_ratio
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1 10G
let i_ac_in = i(VIREF)
let i_ac_out = -i(VVDD) - i(VIREF)
let current_gain_mag = mag(i_ac_out) / mag(i_ac_in)
let current_gain_db = 20 * log10(current_gain_mag)
meas ac max_gain MAX current_gain_db
let target_gain = max_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db when current_gain_db=target_gain fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 10n 20u
let i_tran_in = i(VIREF)
let i_tran_out = -i(VVDD) - i(VIREF)
meas tran i_out_min MIN i_tran_out
meas tran i_out_max MAX i_tran_out

quit
.endc
.end
